title: docs(adr-0034) + test(e2e): record-page authoring via Studio (#1541)
body:
## What

Closes out the B1 / #1541 work with docs + a live e2e:

- **ADR-0034 amendment** — record `page` now joins the per-item `/meta` draft→publish→version model **via Studio** (seam `'page'` #1571 · create object/type/kind #1572 · `createSeed`-from-default #1574 · `PagePreview` edit + publish · `usePageAssignment` render). The runtime end-user "design this page" entry stays intentionally deferred.
- **Live e2e** (`studio-record-page.spec.ts`) — creating a record page bound to `showcase_invoice` in Studio persists `type: record` + `object` + **regions seeded** from `buildDefaultPageSchema` (`record:highlights` etc.), not blank.

## Verification

- Full live suite: **10 passing** (incl. the new spec).

This completes the Studio authoring path for record pages: create (bound + seeded from the default) → design in PagePreview → publish → renders on records — no `sys_page` table, no runtime editor.
